releases.notes: Trigger cards: BUY/SELL live row (left buy UP/DOWN, right sell); both cells use green/red for the trigger side. Docs updated.
Trigger cards: live UP/DOWN status (buy/sell price & shares); remove Take Profit count (green dots); Demo reset icon vertically centered; safer held-settle entry validation. Docs updated.
Trigger price-trend wheel (Min/Max $ Change over Duration when same-side gaps); Demo stats reset icon; held settles wait for official outcome. Docs updated.

Market Triggers sync per user in Mongo (edit on prod or local); one-time migrate from browser storage. Real Trigger Trade only on the production executor. Replay Triggers stay browser-local. Docs updated.
Market + Replay Triggers: create/edit cards, TP/SL as ¢ offsets from fill (100=off), FOK buys capped to band high, held wins as blue dots, Replay Duration bands and trigger stats. Docs updated.
Prediction Profit / Right-Wrong use actual buy fill + Profit prediction (¢), not trigger Ask. Docs updated.
Prediction Trade Sell can use GTD: resting limit at buy + Profit prediction as soon as Buy fills. Docs updated.
Prediction position cards show Buy and Target prices; Prediction Off collapses Trade/settings (info icon still opens the note). Docs updated.
Manual quote click logging; Open Replay multi locked Buy/Sell prices; targets-map hover rings buy/sell pairs. Docs updated.
Replay: per-trade green/red/blue dots (phase + Prediction) in card stats and Open Replay; Right/Wrong from Prediction trade settlement; multi Prediction Duration bands. Docs updated.
Prediction vs phase Auto Trade open race on Live and Replay (first buy holds until sell). Open Replay shows one check/cross per prediction. Docs updated.

Prediction Trade (Market): Trade switch, shares, Buy/Sell order types; real orders when Allow trade is On. Replay Prediction: Order type + Shares with simulated fills. Replay Prediction panel scroll/layout polish. Docs updated.
After a Right Prediction, the detector can re-trigger in the same window while Trigger Area remains open (live and Replay). Docs updated.
Prediction scores by Profit prediction (¢) rise after trigger, not window outcome. Dual Buy/Sell quote controls under Trigger Area. Docs updated.
Held bets settle on the same Gamma clock as Prediction (no extra portfolio wait for Win/Loss). Docs updated.
Prediction Buy status matches quote Buys (fill only after a real buy). Prediction cards: ✓/✕ status; Trigger + Source only (no Market/P/L). Docs updated.
Active Prediction status is a Buy shortcut (UP/DOWN): same style and hover lift as quote Buy boxes; click places that Buy with the same Size/Manual Override/armed gates. Docs updated.
Prediction cards in Positions (pending → right/wrong). Settlement (positions, Prediction, recorder) waits for explicit Gamma resolved markets only — correctness over speed. Docs updated.
Manual Live fills count only on Market/Live (not Schedule cards or Schedule totals). Persist trade source; stop linking manuals to schedule placements. Docs updated.
Fix position-card Market outcome: match Polymarket rows to bet side, settle only on clear ~0/~1 marks or official Gamma outcome (no mid-book flips). Docs updated.
Fix Prediction Wrong scores: freeze Chainlink close/PTB for the predicted window (do not use the next window); prefer settled ~1/0 token prices over Gamma metadata. Docs updated.

Prediction Min Quote (¢) under Max Quote on Market and Replay (default 70; cheapening Buy must be in [Min, Max] when Duration starts). Replay Prediction switcher muted while a Run is active. Docs updated.

Replay Prediction: Max Quote, Shift, Duration, Trigger Area, On/Off (collapses to switcher when Off), Right/Wrong totals; Open Replay prediction badge, scores, and Duration band. Market Prediction Shift (¢). Fill Success label and Trigger Area spacing. Docs updated.
Prediction: configurable Max Quote (¢) above Duration (default 90); trim info tip copy. Docs updated.

Prediction: persist across refresh; background Pending while a new trigger takes the UI; skip triggers at 90¢+ Buy/Sell; triggers/scoring only on deployed host (settings editable anywhere); clickable info panel; Trigger Area rename and Trade UI polish. Docs updated.

Trade Prediction: Detecting status, UP/DOWN scoring with Right/Wrong stats, green/red graph border until window end; Manual Override FAK/FOK; fix premature Wrong scores from mid-book Gamma prices. Docs updated.

Trade Detector (manipulation): per-series On/Off with Duration and Window area; graph border flash on trigger. Settings: Session into User, Stats tab with Fill success; Trade toggle labels show On/Off; remove Trade Latency. Docs updated.
Browser tab title set to Poly Replay.

Admin CRM is Mongo-only: Available/Recording/retention and user admin live in shared Mongo (no poly-replay /api/admin bridge or CRM secret). Drop user disabled flag; Recording applies on recorder sync (~30s). Docs updated.
Open Replay scrubber: smaller handle; can sit slightly past the final plot point (inside the chart) so it does not cover the last price dot.
Open Replay: view-only phase settings on phase click; Settlement-aligned close tip (draw at window end, mirror wrong-side closes); hide schedule-edit hint in view-only phase modal; docs updated.
Open Replay metrics: PTB, Current, and Gap only (equal width); drop quote boxes and book-tick fetch for faster Heroku loads; docs updated.

Open Replay: Market metric boxes (PTB/Current/Gap/Tick + UP/DOWN quotes) above the graph, updating with the scrubber; Chainlink price line + outcome coloring polish; live/Heroku proxies GET /api/ticks to the recorder; docs updated.

Heatmap wallets: Polymarket all-time P/L per trader (not app-user), Address|P/L column order; open/close icon, blue Wallets highlight, disable other color cards while open; address link icons; sort spinner/alignment polish; docs updated.

Heatmap wallets list: top 100 by sightings with I WON/I LOST per user, sortable columns, Polymarket profile links; store per-window traders; 30-day idle wallet prune; Settings Credentials tab; Replay health recovery and UI polish; docs updated.
Heatmap/Replay keep latest UTC weekday×hour only — new recordings override that hour; missed hours keep last week. Disk retention ~14 days. Docs updated.

Live fill-success % (buys+sells, rolling 7 days) on Market → Trade with feed latency; Replay Fill success (%) input with per-attempt random fills, prefills from live; Simulator footer expands for Replay + inputs; docs updated.

Simulator Replay latency (ms) on Schedule; latency/GTD delay applied in the sim engine; Heroku live app proxies Replay (placements, setups, latency) to SCHEDULE_REPLAY_SERVICE_URL and streams card results back; No Data cards, header range spinner, week fill; schedule docs updated.

Fix schedule Replay: match Mongo recorded windows, derive Chainlink assetGap, harden SSE stats streaming, and avoid Dropbox tick-read stalls so weekend cards can finish; schedule docs note local ticks vs heatmap.

Unify recording and Replay in one app: per-market Recording toggle on Market → Trade; ticks/windows under DATA_DIR; schedule Replay runs in-process or via SCHEDULE_REPLAY_SERVICE_URL worker; drop zip archives (delete data older than 7 days); docs updated for live vs recorder roles.

Schedule workspace polish: Live/Demo switcher with sliding handle and Replay screen border; hide Add setup on Heatmap; Replay run button matches Add setup and only shows in Demo; fix Replay card move/delete; docs updated.

Fix: Market P/L no longer keeps false wins after a market resolves to a loss; confirmed win/loss is re-checked against Polymarket; fees use trade USDC notional when available; market docs clarify P/L vs wallet cash.
Position cards show times in UTC (matching the schedule board) and display the buy fill immediately while the trade is still pending confirmation.

Fix: header Market totals now render reliably (in-flight fetches are coalesced and late responses still display); stats range selection is no longer forced when switching pages; legacy btc_5m stat events normalized to btc-5m.
Header Market range is all-time for the selected series; empty stats show 0 / +$0.00 instead of dashes; schedule docs updated.
Gap vs PTB First and Both (same rules for FAK and GTD); setup delete and locked schedule-card removal confirmations; docs updates.
Schedule setups list scrolls when cards overflow, using the same thin scrollbar as the log panel.
Schedule Replay mode: separate setups and placements from Live, Live/Replay switcher, Replay run button (service URL stub), and docs for Replay.
Shorter product docs; Docs/Versions no longer flash Market on refresh; Poly Real title and App label stay stable; docs section hover no longer shifts layout.
Settings button and top bar height matched across Market/Schedule/Settings and Docs/Versions.
GTD resting buys cancel ~3s before phase end and the next phase places without waiting on cancel; docs section layout/hover polish; Settings stays available on Docs/Versions when signed in.
Settings Documentation card moved to the top as a single-row label + Open control.

Docs & Versions as /docs and /version routes; setups/phases and information-flow docs with UI demos and flow diagrams; docs search; Settings link to documentation; signed-in Back control; docs permission Cursor rules.
Homepage Main / Docs / Versions tabs; right-column auth layout; Markdown product docs under public/docs; versions changelog; Cursor rules for dev→main workflow.
Initial Poly Real app: auth, Market, Schedule / Heatmap, Settings, and live/demo trading.
